subject: railgunCarrier
pitch:
Category: Vehicle.
Subject: six-wheeled railgun carrier braced on stabiliser legs.
Style: low-poly sci-fi military.
reasoning:
I'm sketching the overall design: a six-wheeled heavy carrier roughly 9m long and 3m wide, with a box chassis, front cab, and a rear turret mounting a railgun with long rails plus deployable hydraulic outrigger legs for stabilization.

I'm working out coordinates for the skeleton -- wheel radius, axle positions, hull dimensions, cab placement, and turret location -- and figuring out how to orient the railgun so it arcs forward over the cab at a slight elevation angle rather than straight back.

For the stabilizer legs I'm placing four at the hull corners, each with a mount joint, angled hydraulic rod, and a pad cylinder sized to just touch the ground.

Now I'm detailing wheels with tire cylinders, rims, hubs, lugs and tread blocks built from a helper function, giving each a spin joint and adding mudguard covers above them. I'm picking an olive drab hull with dark steel and tan accents plus cyan glow rails, then setting up the box/cylinder/part helper functions and starting the chassis joint hierarchy and rail geometry.

Working out turret and railgun placement...

To clear the cab roof I'll raise the pitch joint and rails to y 2.9 and extend the turret housing to y 3.3, applying a -8° pose rotation on the pitch axis to tip the barrel up correctly. For texturing, I'm planning hazard-stripe SVGs on the legs and bumper, a unit emblem decal on the hull side, and a display texture on the cab, all as textured plane parts.
